integrity: The proof starts from the exact U and convolution identities in the recent full text. A packaged symbolic checker independently performs series reversion, kernel expansion, beta convolution, boundary factorization, and conversion from E to log r. The resulting quadratic coefficient reproduces the published Li--Wan coefficient as an internal consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a local r-downarrow-1 asymptotic on the degenerate monotonicity boundary. It does not replace the global period classification. The recent preprint has no displayed MSC line; 52A10 is verified from Li--Wan's classification of the identical planar isotropic L_p dual Minkowski problem, whose arXiv metadata lists 52A10 first, and from the support-function formulation in both papers.
title: Sixth-order endpoint law on the degenerate Minkowski-period boundary
